axis_semantics: Counts candidate SR updates. Additional historical callback and sampling work is not included in this nominal count.
training_energy_semantics: Row update s is measured before applying that update. Plot positions are (s-1) times candidate solves per step.
endpoint_semantics: Independent endpoint energy evaluation; individual errors are Monte Carlo standard errors. The paired t interval across all five differences is conditional on one shared source state.
timing_benchmark: Separate TFIM experiment for the NTK-quantile implementation, one H100 80GB, medians across three paired device/seed settings.
